ITEM 1 | Long thin green strands, slender pods about 5-8 cm long, some with darker blackened or charred spots and slight wrinkling, dull matte surface with a faint oily sheen, piled in a loose tangled heap covering roughly 40% of the plate's right half, holding shape with no sauce pooling | 85

ITEM 2 | Flat strips of cooked meat, reddish-brown to golden with crisp browned edges and translucent pale fat areas, thin ribbon-like pieces about 1 cm wide and 8-10 cm long, slightly glossy with rendered fat, lying in an overlapping pile on the lower left of the plate next to the green strands | 40
